title: 3.0beta11
symptom: BG values received in AAPS are more than 10 minutes late compared to BYODA, causing the loop to be outdated. The issue occurs intermittently, and restarting AAPS or the phone only temporarily resolves it.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. MilosKozak states that AAPS receives broadcast later and believes the issue is related to the phone. Philoul speculates that Room has increased CPU workload, but MilosKozak disagrees that calculations would delay broadcasts by minutes.
fix: The thread does not state a definitive fix. Catherinefranq reports that deleting the Dexcom bridge in Heroku resolved the issue for her, but this is anecdotal and not confirmed by maintainers.
evidence_quote: j'ai supprimé le bridge dans heroku et pour l'instant j'ai plus de problèmes à voir dans le temps merci
